name: Voxel Edit Brush Operations — Place/Carve/Fill/Paint, Real-time Voxel Editing, VoxelEdit
definition: A shader patching utility that injects voxel carving logic into a fragment shader using a 3D texture mask and uniform parameters for voxel-to-world mapping.
summary: VoxelEdit enables real-time, GPU-accelerated sculpting of volumetric data by injecting a binary occupancy mask into a fragment shader to perform crisp, axis-aligned carve operations without modifying underlying geometry.
